name: [💜] VexDuels
desc:
VEXIUM PvP

Welcome to Vexium PvP, a fast-paced third-person shooter where skill, strategy, and teamwork determine every battle. Challenge players, master your weapons, and climb the ranks to become a champion.

🎮 Game Modes
• Free For All (FFA)
• 1v1 Duels
• Team Battles (2v2–5v5)
• Clan Wars

✨ Features
• Smooth third-person combat
• Sprint, roll, and crouch mechanics
• Weapon skins and cosmetics
• Create or join a clan
• Leaderboards, events, and rewards

🏆 Progress
Earn XP, unlock rewards, improve your skills, and become one of the best players in **Vexium PvP**.

❤️ Support
Enjoying the game? Like, Favorite, and **Follow** to support future updates and Rewards.
